brains.title: Brains
brains.hint: Keys and endpoints the workspace can run models on. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
brains.credentialsEmpty: No credentials yet. Add an API key or point at an endpoint.
brains.label: Label
brains.profilesEmpty: No brains yet. Name a model to run on.
brains.modelHint: Pick one the credential lists, or type an id.
brains.defaultForHint: One brain per workspace holds each title; giving it to another takes it from the first. Embedding is the model the codebase index uses.
connections.title: Connections
connections.hint: Services Perch can reach on your behalf. Tokens are encrypted and never shown again.
connections.empty: Connect a service to clone, push, and open pull requests.
connections.apiBaseHint: For a service you host yourself, such as GitHub Enterprise. Leave empty for the public one.
connections.wizardHint: Create the app on GitHub with the callback URL below and a webhook endpoint made here, install it on your repositories, then paste its ID, private key, and installation ID.
connections.webhookHint: GitHub posts the app's events to an endpoint Perch makes for it. Choose the channel its cards go to, make the endpoint, then paste its URL and secret into the app's webhook settings.
connections.webhookSecretOnce: The secret is shown this once. Paste it into GitHub now.
connections.webhookAdminOnly: An admin makes the webhook endpoint a GitHub App posts to.
connections.webhookNoChannels: Make a channel first: a webhook posts its cards into one.
forge.title: Bots
forge.hint: A bot is a member of the workspace that answers when it is named. Start from a template or make your own.
forge.emptyHint: Pick a template below, or fill in the form.
nest.title: The Nest
nest.hint: A team of agents that join as members: Birbus runs the Nest, the specialists do the work. Installing them makes ordinary bots you can edit or delete.
nest.tokens: Tokens, shown once. Copy them now — Perch keeps only a hash.
forge.name: Name
forge.dailyHint: In dollars. Leave empty for no cap.
policy.title: Policy
policy.hint: What may happen here: which branches are protected, which commands are refused, which models a channel may use, and what may be spent. Written as YAML, the same file a project can carry in .perch/policy.yaml.
policy.readOnly: Only an admin can change this.
policy.tryItHint: A dry run: nothing happens either way.
connections.lane.mcp_oauth: Sign in through its MCP server
connections.mcpUrlHint: For a service you host yourself. Leave empty for the public one.
connections.byoAppHint: Register an OAuth app with the provider and paste its client id here. Perch will use it instead of registering one itself.
connections.grantsHint: A bot, an automation or a session. A connection that belongs to you can be used by a shared bot only on your behalf.
forge.tokensHint: A token lets a program outside Perch act as this bot. It is shown once.
forge.tokenNamePlaceholder: CI, my laptop, the newsroom script
forge.tokenOnce: Copy it now: this is the only time Perch will show it.
